From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Org entry & credential staging plan

Hi Anya —

Great to meet you last week. To make the first week of implementation frictionless, here’s a compact plan for the initial tenant/org entry and credential staging we discussed. Goal: get ClearPath’s prod-ish sandbox live with seeded service accounts, an admin roster, and the API key/project structure so your devs can start smoke-testing.

High-level asks (from your side):
- Confirm SSO metadata (IdP -> SP) and whether you want Redwood-managed SAML or rely on OAuth/OIDC.
- Confirm KMS preference (AWS KMS vs your HSM) for seeding long-lived service keys.

Proposed technical plan (Redwood responsibilities in bold):
1) Project & namespace layout
   - Create two namespaces: clearpath-prod-sandbox and clearpath-dev-sandbox.
   - Seed one admin group (3 users) and two service accounts per namespace (infrastructure + ingestion).
2) API keys & seeding (Monica to generate seed artifacts)
   - Generate two scoped API keys per service account; keys will be short-lived (90d TTL) and rotated immediately after verification.
   - If you want KMS-wrapped keys, we’ll exchange KMS policy docs and do a handoff window.
3) Invite cadence and roles (Sofia to coordinate invites)
   - Day 0: Admin invites + infrastructure service accounts seeded (no dev keys).
   - Day 2: Dev service accounts & scoped API keys seeded; dev team begins smoke tests.
4) Observability & audit
   - Enable tenant-level audit logs and baseline latency/cost dashboards; we’ll share an access link.

Attachments: access_matrix.xlsx (role -> permission mapping), tenant_onboarding_checklist.pdf (kickoff checklist).

Proposed dates (flexible):
- Kickoff (Day 0): Tue, Aug 25 — create namespaces & seed admin invites
- Seed keys (Day 2): Thu, Aug 27 — seed service keys, validation window Fri, Aug 28

Can you confirm:
- Which window works for your ops team? (We suggested Tue/Thu above.)
- Do you prefer KMS wrapping or direct key handoff?

If that looks good I’ll convert this into a short mutual action plan and assign owners.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan — this looks clear and pragmatic. Two quick notes from my side:

1) Availability: Tue, Aug 25 morning (09:00–12:00 PT) works best for our ops team; Thu is also possible but morning preferred.
2) KMS: we have an AWS KMS account we prefer to use for wrapping long-term secrets; we can create a key alias for Redwood to use during the seeding window.

If you can draft the sequence for a KMS-wrapped seed (and the minimal IAM policy we should provision), we’ll approve that and schedule Tue morning.

Thanks Anya — thanks Jordan for the outline. I’m attaching the access_matrix.xlsx and the onboarding checklist with the detailed steps. Summary of my recommended sequence and exact ops commands we’ll run during the Tue window: 

A. Namespace + role creation (Day 0 — Tue morning)
   - Create namespaces: clearpath-prod-sandbox, clearpath-dev-sandbox
   - Create roles: tenant-admin, infra-service, ingest-service, dev-user (scoped to read-only test workloads)
   - Add 3 admin invites to tenant-admin (Anya, yours + one backup)

B. Service account seed (Day 0 — after admin invites accepted)
   - Create two service identities per namespace: infra-svc, ingest-svc
   - Generate unwrapped API keys for validation only (we will not deliver production keys until KMS wrap is confirmed).

C. KMS-wrapped production keys (Day 2 — Thu or as agreed)
   - Monica will generate a key-wrapping request and provide an envelope to your KMS alias: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/alias/clearpath-redwood (we’ll send the minimal IAM policy in the Drive doc).
   - Once your KMS team confirms, we’ll produce wrapped keys and store a reference in tenant metadata; actual plaintext keys never cross email/plaintext.

D. Rotation and TTLs
   - Initial policy: 90d TTL for seed keys; auto-rotate after 30d once production telemetry is live.

E. Validation plan (Day 2–3)
   - Smoke tests: token exchange + sample generation (SLO: < 120ms p95 for short prompts).
   - Observability: we’ll provision a temporary dashboard link and give your team read-only viewer.

Docs / artifacts I’m attaching: access_matrix.xlsx, tenant_onboarding_checklist.pdf — the Drive link in the checklist has the exact IAM snippet and the HubSpot deal (see link below).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/CLP-2026-HP7231
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aexample

If that all looks right I’ll:
- Create the namespace and pre-stage role definitions on Tue at 09:00 PT
- Produce the IAM snippet and the KMS policy (IMP-1123) and share with Anya’s ops contact for approval

/Monica
Monica Patel
